title: Activate approved desktop UI reference 1.5

trigger.denial: The governed desktop verification activation and baseline still name Academic Minimal 1.4 after the repository owner approved the immutable Academic Minimal 1.5 package. A renderer implementation against 1.5 would therefore be measured against stale verification authority.
trigger.atomicity: The exact 1.5 reference is approved at predecessor 6ed8e76fb52349780cccac913b3652553a57afbd. No 1.5 product implementation is present in that predecessor, CAP-03.S05 remains in slice remediation, and the unrelated W1.A04.B00 evidence file remains untracked and untouched.
trigger.diagnosis: Reference identity and package hash are evidence-control inputs. They must move to the already approved immutable package in a control-only commit before product code adopts that reference, with independent review of the exact two-field projection change.

authority: This maintenance activates only the exact human-approved RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.5 identity and package hash for existing desktop verification. It preserves the verification mode, target and application roots, schemas, commands, baseline measurements, implementation inventory, W1 packet, CAP-03.S05 scope, task and slice states, security authority, and release gate. It does not implement UI behavior, approve a task or slice, change product scope, weaken a check, authorize egress, or approve G1.

intendedDelta.implementation: Replace only referenceId and referencePackageSha256 in the desktop UI activation and baseline with the exact values from the approved 1.5 manifest. Preserve every other JSON value and commit the maintenance record with those two control files before any 1.5 renderer implementation.
failClosed: The activation and baseline must bind the same reference identity and package hash.
The identity and hash must equal the immutable human-approved reference manifest.
No verification mode, path, command, threshold, viewport, implementation root, or baseline observation may change.
No product, build, planning, task-state, or release-gate file may enter the candidate commit.
The renderer implementation remains inadmissible until an independent reviewer approves this exact candidate.

verification.riskAnalysis: The remediation changes evidence-authority validation, immutable baseline-history interpretation, and the two reference provenance scalars after the corrected exact package was human-approved. Selected checks cover both supported approval grammars, exact proposal-to-approval ancestry, fail-closed interleaving, rejected-candidate history, malformed-history retention, the full focused UI gate module, reference reproducibility, JSON/Git hygiene, and unchanged product behavior. Product runtime, persistence, API, security policy, and packaging behavior remain unchanged and are covered by the later renderer implementation and slice review.

results.detail: The corrected human approval is commit 7ec1b27d72c189216d7a203586b7339202733531 and its reproducible Academic Minimal 1.5 package SHA-256 is 38435454e7128264e74492b3e372843d5cc5e02641611624a96bc85b92af38ae.

All 36 tests in tests.foundation.test_ui_change_gate pass in 70.661 seconds, including exact provenance handoff acceptance, unrelated-interleaving denial, adverse-review preservation, substitution denial, and existing activation paths.
Focused desktop-conformance tests accept the historical 1.4 amendment/ECR authority, authenticate the exact 1.5 Wave/slice proposal and approval, and reject an unresolvable Wave authority commit.

Five focused history tests pass in 2.859 seconds: only introduced baseline bytes trigger lineage work, an exact adopted adverse-review attestation is required to retain a rejected candidate, unattested suppression fails closed, same-ID rewrites remain denied, and malformed history remains visible.

Both activation JSON files parse and bind the same corrected 1.5 package hash; the visual baseline additionally binds corrected approval commit 7ec1b27d72c189216d7a203586b7339202733531. No product or baseline measurement value changed.

The authoritative repository-history check intentionally remains fail-closed while this remediation is only a changes-requested candidate; it must pass against the exact adopted R02 projection before product implementation is committed.

remediation.rootCause: The initial candidate treated the new reference ID and package hash as sufficient provenance, retained the stale 1.4 approval commit, and relied on a conformance validator that supported only the older amendment/ECR authority grammar. The first 1.5 approval also contained a mistyped Wave packet SHA, so its immutable bytes could not be made truthful in place.
remediation.resolution: A provenance-only proposal and explicit human approval corrected the Wave packet binding without changing the governed experience. The baseline now binds that exact approval commit and package. The conformance validator authenticates both exact legacy amendment/ECR and Wave/slice authority forms, verifies immutable proposal consumption and Wave/slice approval ancestry, and validates baseline lineage only where bytes are introduced. The UI gate permits the two intervening reference-governance commits only when they form that exact human-approved transition; the rejected initial candidate remains visible and non-authoritative until this remediation is independently adopted.
remediation.recurrenceControl: Focused real-Git tests cover exact corrected authority, unresolvable authority denial, exact provenance-only interleaving, unrelated interleaving denial, adopted adverse-review attestation, unattested suppression denial, same-reference rewrite denial, and malformed historical snapshot retention. The complete focused UI gate module is replayed before R02, and authoritative repository baseline history is replayed after adoption.

rollback: If independent review finds a blocking defect, do not implement the 1.5 renderer. Return to predecessor 6ed8e76fb52349780cccac913b3652553a57afbd, which retains the approved 1.5 reference while desktop product verification remains bound to the previously active 1.4 package.
